description: The three statements introduced wholesale at 8.0 - CREATE VECTOR INDEX, ALTER VECTOR INDEX, DROP VECTOR INDEX - carry no version marker at all, while the *capability added to an existing statement* (Composite Vector indexes via CREATE INDEX) does carry one: 'In Couchbase Server 8.0 and later'. The asymmetry is systematic rather than accidental: an existing statement needs an 'and later' qualifier to mark what changed, whereas a brand-new statement's page has nothing to contrast with, so it is left unmarked. The consequence for readers is that the newest features are the hardest to date.
